description.narrative: Prevenire, identificare e gestire tempestivamente le situazioni di rischio materno-infantile mediante la creazione e lo sviluppo di una rete territoriale organizzata su più livelli di assistenza.
Ridurre la morbilità e la mortalità materna e infantile associate alle nascite premature e alle malformazioni congenite nel breve e lungo periodo in un’ottica di diritto alla salute

Scopo dell’iniziativa è il capacity building di alto livello del personale e delle strutture sanitarie coinvolte. Si prevede di ottimizzare le strutture sanitarie ed i protocolli esistenti grazie alla solida esperienza clinica delle Istituzioni partner italiane coinvolte, L’Università degli Studi ed il Policlinico “S.Matteo” di Pavia, L’Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore ed il Policlinico Universitario “Agostino Gemelli” di Roma.

The aim of the initiative is high-level capacity building of the involved maternal health staff and hospitals. It is expected to optimize the existing healthcare structures and protocols thanks to the solid clinical experience of the Italian partner institutions involved, the Università degli Studi and the Policlinico “S.Matteo” of Pavia, the Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore and the Policlinico Universitario “Agostino Gemelli” of Rome.

sector.narrative: Personnel development for population and reproductive health

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls

By 2030, end preventable deaths of newborns and children under 5 years of age, with all countries aiming to reduce neonatal mortality to at least as low as 12 per 1,000 live births and under-5 mortality to at least as low as 25 per 1,000 live births
By 2030, ensure equal access for all women and men to affordable and quality technical, vocational and tertiary education, including university

By 2030, ensure universal access to sexual and reproductive health-care services, including for family planning, information and education, and the integration of reproductive health into national strategies and programmes
By 2030, reduce the global maternal mortality ratio to less than 70 per 100,000 live births
Eliminate all forms of violence against all women and girls in the public and private spheres, including trafficking and sexual and other types of exploitation
End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere
Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages
Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all

Substantially increase health financing and the recruitment, development, training and retention of the health workforce in developing countries, especially in least developed countries and small island developing States
